items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Bebe played the drum with us too. ... Which band though? Silver Leaf.

ctx.x: Black Happy had a stroke, but he still, he can walk around some day, he gets out some, you know? Oh yeah, we have. You remember Black Happy, huh? He was another drummer too. Probably so. You'd know him if you saw him, Goldson. And then all the Matthews brothers, there was a happy among all the Matthews, you know Bill? Oh Bill I hope. Yeah. Well he had another brother, Bebe, and another one happy.

Bebe played the drum with us too. With which band? Not the trombone player. Bill is the trombone player. Yeah. But Bebe was the drummer. But Bebe played with us too, but not regular, you know? Which band though? Silver Leaf.
Silver Leaf. I see. So we're getting some of the guys to substitute him. Yeah that's right. Was Willie Santiago in there regular or is the substitute?
